info.name: Workflow Tracker API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Workflow Tracker backend.

Base URL is stored in the `baseUrl` collection variable (default: http://localhost:8000/api).

The happy-path folder runs all transitions in order — create → submit → start-review → decision.
Use the included environment file to persist the `appId` variable across requests.

variable.description: Primary key of the application under test. Update after creating an application.

item.name: Applications — CRUD
item.description: Create, list, retrieve, and update applications.

request.description:
Create a new application in **Draft** status. A unique tracking number (`APP-YYYYMMDD-XXXXX`) is generated automatically.

Copy the returned `id` and set it as the `appId` collection variable to use the workflow endpoints.

item.name: Workflow Actions
item.description:
Status transition endpoints. Each moves the application through the workflow state machine.

Expected order: submit → start-review → decision.
If decision is `Need More Information`, the applicant calls resubmit, then the cycle restarts from start-review.

request.description:
Transition: **Draft → Submitted**

Sets `submitted_at` to the current UTC time. Fails with `400` if the application is not in `Draft` status.

response.name: 200 OK
response.body:
{
  "id": 1,
  "tracking_number": "APP-20260520-A3F9C",
  "applicant_name": "Jane Doe",
  "applicant_email": "jane@example.com",
  "company_name": "Acme Ltd",
  "application_type": "Renewal",
  "description": "Annual licence renewal for permit #1234.",
  "status": "Submitted",
  "reviewer_comment": null,
  "created_at": "2026-05-20T09:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-05-20T09:10:00Z",
  "submitted_at": "2026-05-20T09:10:00Z",
  "reviewed_at": null
}

response.name: 400 Bad Request — wrong status
404 Not Found

request.description:
Transition: **Submitted → Under Review**

Fails with `400` if the application is not in `Submitted` status.

response.name: 200 OK
response.body:

response.name: 400 Bad Request — wrong status

request.description:
Transition: **Under Review → Approved**

Comment is optional for an `Approved` decision. Sets `reviewed_at` to the current UTC time.

`comment` is **required** for a `Rejected` decision. Returns `400` if omitted.

request.description:
Transition: **Under Review → Need More Information**

`comment` is **required** — it tells the applicant what to provide. After this, the applicant calls `resubmit` to cycle back to `Submitted`.

request.description:

Updates `submitted_at` to the current UTC time. Fails with `400` if the application is not in `Need More Information` status.

item.name: Happy Path — Full Workflow
item.description:
Run these requests in order to walk a single application through the complete approval workflow:

1. Create Application  
2. Submit  
3. Start Review  
4. Decision (Approved)

After step 1, copy the returned `id` into the `appId` collection variable before continuing.

body.raw:
{
  "applicant_name": "Happy Path User",
  "applicant_email": "happy@example.com",
  "company_name": "Happy Path Corp",
  "application_type": "Renewal",
  "description": "Happy path end-to-end test application."
}

request.description: Creates the application and automatically sets `appId` via the test script.

item.name: Need More Info — Re-review Workflow
item.description:
Demonstrates the 'Need More Information' branch:

1. Create Application  
2. Submit  
3. Start Review  
4. Decision (Need More Information)  
5. Update Application (add missing info)  
6. Resubmit  
7. Start Review (again)  
8. Decision (Approved)

Step 1 auto-sets `appId` via the test script.

body.raw:
{
  "applicant_name": "Re-review User",
  "applicant_email": "rereview@example.com",
  "company_name": "Re-review Corp",
  "application_type": "Change of Name",
  "description": "Requesting a change of registered name."
}
